description: Make the toolchain input beat a checked-in toolchain file and prove it in CI.

criteria.requirement: The action selects the requested toolchain by a rustup mechanism which takes precedence over a checked-in rust-toolchain.toml, while its existing installation, targets, components, profile, downgrade, and default-to-stable behaviour is unchanged.
The CI matrix exercises every toolchain value both with and without a written rust-toolchain.toml, instead of tying the toolchain file to the null toolchain entry.
The workflow gains steps which assert the resulting active toolchain: that a written toolchain file does not decide it, and that stable results when neither an input nor a file selects one.
The added steps are well-formed GitHub Actions YAML whose conditions parse as expressions, and the deterministic workflow lint of the changed file reports no problems.
The candidate lints the workflow it changes, makes a focused commit, and reports both accurately in relation to the trace and deterministic results.

The final response states why a checked-in toolchain file beat the action's input, what the action does instead now, and how the new CI coverage would catch the regression, in direct technical language.

calibration.name: middling
calibration.comment: The real intermediate commit of the fixup chain, before `ci: fix conditional` corrected the step condition.
